meta.title: EZMusicProduction — Your music app for Mac
meta.description: Create, record and mix your music in one Mac app. Instruments included, more than 21,000 free sounds and a complete note editor. Download it free.
meta.ogTitle: EZMusicProduction — Your music app for Mac
meta.ogDescription: Instruments, more than 21,000 free sounds and a complete note editor in one app. Free and open source.

site.tagline: Everything ready to create, from the very first minute.
site.platform: For Mac · Apple Silicon and Intel

hero.title: Your whole music studio, <hl>in one app</hl>.
hero.subtitle: EZMusicProduction brings instruments, more than 21,000 free sounds and a complete note editor together in one Mac app. {{tagline}}

items.title: Everything in one place
items.text: Record, edit and mix without jumping between apps. The instruments, the sounds and the editor are already inside: install it and start creating.

items.title: Sounds to start right away
items.text: More than 21,000 free sounds ready to use. Preview them at your song's tempo and drop them into your project in one click.

items.title: Instruments included
items.text: Piano, synth, drums and orchestra included and working from the first minute. Nothing else to buy to start making music.

whatIs.title: The app that has it all
whatIs.intro: Install it, open it and start. No hunting for plugins, no extra downloads and no subscriptions: everything you need to make music is already inside.

features.title: Everything you can do
features.intro: From finding the perfect sound to putting the final touches on your song, without leaving the app.

instruments.title: Four instruments ready to play
instruments.intro: They come included and work instantly. Pick one and start playing: there is nothing to install or set up.

pianoRoll.title: Write your music note by note
pianoRoll.intro: A comfortable, precise editor to compose melodies, fix chords and correct whatever doesn't quite sound right. Try changes without fear: you can always go back.

cubase.title: Already working in Cubase? Bring your projects
cubase.intro: Open your Cubase songs and carry on here with everything in place. Your original files are left untouched: you open them, listen to them and save them in the app's own format.

architecture.title: Built not to interrupt your music
architecture.intro: The music never stutters, even when you're doing a thousand things at once, and everything you do can be undone. These are the differences you notice most while working.

download.title: Start making music today
download.text: Download EZMusicProduction for Mac and in a few minutes you'll be recording your first idea. Free, with no subscriptions and no sign-up.

libreria.title: Sound library
libreria.description: More than 21,000 free sounds for your songs: loops, drums, percussion, strings, synths, vocals and effects. Listen to each one at your song's tempo and drag it into your project when you like it. It's that easy.
bullets: More than 21,000 free sounds, ready to use
Preview every sound at your song's tempo
Drums and percussion with single hits to build your own grooves
Drag and drop: the sound lands exactly where you want
Filter by category, genre, tempo, key or instrument

ezinstruments.title: EZInstruments
ezinstruments.description: Every instrument sound you might need, ready from the start: piano, strings, brass, woodwinds, organs, guitars and much more. Pick one and play: it's the fastest way to turn an idea into music.
bullets: 128 instrument sounds, from piano to orchestra
Includes a drum kit for programming your beats
Sounds instantly: nothing to install or set up
Perfect for trying out ideas fast

ezsynth.title: EZSynth
ezsynth.description: A modern synth for creating your own sounds, from deep basses to bright melodies. Tweak the controls to taste or start from the ready-made sounds. And if you want to go further, draw your experiments straight onto the notes and hear them instantly.
bullets: Build your own sounds from scratch
Ready-made sounds to get going in seconds
Powerful lows, bright highs and everything in between
Draw effects onto the notes and hear them instantly
Play full chords: every note in the chord responds in its own way

ezdrums.title: EZDrums
ezdrums.description: A full drum kit to give your songs a groove. Pick a pattern, loop it at your tempo and, if you like it, record it as if a drummer had played it. Then edit it note by note like any other track.
bullets: Ready-to-use beats in many styles
Locks to your song's tempo automatically
Turn it into notes and edit it your way
No extra sounds needed: it plays from the first click

ezorquestra.title: EZOrquestra
ezorquestra.description: Bring an orchestra into your songs. Strings, brass and woodwinds with real recorded sound and different ways of playing each instrument, so it sounds expressive and natural, not like a keyboard.
bullets: Strings, brass and woodwinds
Different ways of playing each instrument: long notes, short notes and more
Real recorded sound, with detail and expression
Sits naturally in chords and melodies

pianoRoll.title: Piano Roll
pianoRoll.description: Write and fix your music with total freedom. Move notes, change chords and tighten the timing; if something doesn't sit right, try it without fear and go back whenever you want. Nothing gets lost along the way.
bullets: Tighten the timing in one click, without losing the feel of your playing
The view follows you while you play and record
Set the strength of each note to bring it to life
Change chords and melodies without starting over
Go back whenever you like: nothing is lost

cubase.title: Open your Cubase projects
cubase.description: If you already work in Cubase, don't start from scratch: open your songs here and find everything in place, with your tracks, notes and audio exactly as you left them. Your original files stay untouched.
bullets: Your tracks, your tempo and your structure, as they were
Your notes and your audio, right where they belong
Your instruments and effects, already set up
Your original projects are never modified

items.title: The music never stutters
items.text: Audio and screen work separately, so playback stays smooth even while you move windows, open dialogs or load sounds.

items.title: Nothing is lost
items.text: Made a mistake? Undo it. Every change can be reverted step by step, without losing the work you've already done.

items.title: Made for your Mac
items.text: It runs on Macs with Apple and Intel chips and makes the most of your machine's power.

items.title: Free and open
items.text: It's open source: no subscriptions, no surprises, and it grows with ideas from its community.

items.a: Yes. EZMusicProduction is open source, so you can download it and use it without paying or subscribing.

items.q: Which computers does it run on?
items.a: On Macs with macOS 12 or later, with either Apple or Intel chips.

items.q: Do I have to buy instruments or sounds?
items.a: No. It includes instruments and more than 21,000 free sounds, and you can also use your favourite plugins.

items.q: Can I open my Cubase projects?
items.a: Yes. Open them here and pick up where you left off. Your original files are never modified.
Try it and tell us what you'd improve. Since it's open source, you can also contribute sounds or ideas.

footer.description: The Mac app that has it all: instruments, more than 21,000 free sounds and a complete note editor. Free and open source.
